skills.name: detect-directories
skills.description: Discover additional source directories outside the project root that should be accessible. Used internally by /project-setup.
skills.description_zh: 发现项目根目录之外需要可访问的额外源码目录，由/project-setup内部调用。

skills.name: detect-environment
skills.description: Detect language runtimes, virtual environments, and toolchains (Python, Node, Rust, Go). Used internally by /project-setup.
skills.description_zh: 检测Python、Node、Rust和Go的语言运行时、虚拟环境及工具链，由/project-setup内部调用。

skills.name: detect-ide-settings
skills.description: Read IDE/editor configuration files (VSCode, PyCharm, Vim/Neovim, Emacs) to discover project settings. Used internally by /project-setup.
skills.description_zh: 读取VSCode、PyCharm、Vim/Neovim和Emacs的编辑器配置以发现项目设置，由/project-setup内部调用。

skills.name: detect-linters
skills.description: Detect linters and formatters configured in the project across Python, JS/TS, Rust, and Go. Used internally by /project-setup.
skills.description_zh: 检测项目已配置的Python、JS/TS、Rust和Go代码检查器及格式化工具，由/project-setup内部调用。

skills.name: detect-runtime-context
skills.description: Detect whether the project is running locally or in a remote/container environment (GitHub Codespaces, VS Code Dev Containers, Gitpod, SSH, etc.). Used internally by /project-setup.
skills.description_zh: 识别项目运行于本地还是Codespaces、Dev Containers、Gitpod、SSH等远程或容器环境，由/project-setup内部调用。

skills.name: detect-test-runners
skills.description: Detect test runners and testing configuration across Python, JS/TS, Rust, and Go. Used internally by /project-setup.
skills.description_zh: 检测Python、JS/TS、Rust和Go的测试运行器及测试配置，由/project-setup内部调用。
